features.title: Guardian of the wild
features.text: Druids channel the primal magic of nature, calling storms, commanding plants, befriending beasts or changing shape.

features.title: Druidic order
features.text: The order sets the druid's signature focus spell and style, from a loyal animal companion to turning into a monster mid-fight.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3 → 3–4.5. Primal area spells and offensive orders support high damage; healing-focused selections contribute less.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5–4. Order, shields and form choices can change personal resilience substantially.
ratings.support: 4 → 3.5–5. Healing, control and companion choices offer several strong support approaches.
ratings.utility: 5 → 4–5. Primal exploration spells and nature tools are broad; preparation decides the day's answers.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 3.5. Daily preparation plus an order's extra mechanics require moderate planning.
